note: Claude Code MCP template for the bundled deck-assistant stdio server. Official docs verified on 2026-06-21: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/mcp. Use as .mcp.json for project scope or with claude mcp add-json. Replace PYTHONPATH with the absolute paths to the deployed packages/core/src and packages/mcp-server/src; the Decky native pack install writes these automatically into the managed Claude workspace.
